cbf.uses: 1 channel, T=64: univariate. With labels (3 classes, balanced): suited to evaluating class-conditional generation. Origin: generated Cylinder-Bell-Funnel, 3 classes.

stock_full.uses: 6 channels, T=24: multivariate. No labels: unconditional generation only. Origin: like stock but with all windows (long).
